card.name: First digit of two-digit day numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit that starts the tens place of a two-digit number in dosing schedules or ranges, such as the 1 in Day 15 or the 2 in Days 271-360. It fires where the number is split into separate digits.

modes.label: Day 15 in schedules
modes.description: The leading 1 of day 15 after a Day label in a dosing or cycle table.

modes.label: Digit in ranges
modes.description: A leading digit inside a numeric range of days, months or mg.

card.plain: It marks the first digit of a two-digit number, mostly the 1 in day 15, within dosing schedules and ranges.
